title: Lightning Stick
description: Strike down lightning wherever you point! This magical stick lets you summon powerful bolts to zap your enemies or light up the battlefield. Easy to use, fun to play
body:
🌩️ Lightning Stick

Unleash the power of lightning with this magical stick! 

With the Lightning Stick, you can:

Strike lightning exactly where you’re looking
Zap enemies or mobs instantly

This mod is easy to use, fun for all players, and perfect for anyone who loves a little chaos in Minecraft. just grab the stick, right-click, and watch the storm unfold!

Features:

Lightning strikes exactly where you point
Fun and interactive for combat or pranks
Works in both survival and creative

Add a spark to your world — bring the storm with the Lightning Stick!
